replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The cell death bar graph in panel A explicitly reports mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, giving both an n-number (3) and a replicate type (independent experiments). The accompanying blots are representative images without separate quantification, so no additional replicate reporting is required for them.
